abstract: This study determines the effects of green energy (GE), natural resources (NR), gross savings (GS), financial development (FD) and technological innovation (TI) on the economic growth (EG) of Pakistan by using the symmetric novel ARDL technique to identify the nexus among variables with the dynamics of short- and long-run. In order to evaluate the strength and reliability of the findings, the study also used the Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) technique. Empirical findings demonstrate that natural resources, gross savings, and financial development have a substantial impact on economic growth, in both the short term and long term. However, renewable energy utilization and technological innovation have a detrimental influence on economic growth. The Pakistani government should consider conservative strategies and approaches that prioritize renewable energy and technological innovation by creating new financial incentives. The study’s findings provide specific policy suggestions for developing economies to enhance technology, innovation and financial institutions, thereby enhancing economic progress.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用对称新颖的ARDL技术，识别变量间在短期与长期动态中的关联，以确定绿色能源（GE）、自然资源（NR）、总储蓄（GS）、金融发展（FD）和技术创新（TI）对巴基斯坦经济增长（EG）的影响。为评估研究结果的稳健性与可靠性，本研究还采用了广义矩估计（GMM）技术。实证结果表明，自然资源、总储蓄和金融发展在短期和长期内均对经济增长具有显著影响。然而，可再生能源利用和技术创新对经济增长产生不利影响。巴基斯坦政府应考虑保守的策略与方法，通过创造新的财政激励措施来优先发展可再生能源和技术创新。本研究的研究结果为发展中经济体提供了具体的政策建议，以提升技术、创新和金融机构，从而促进经济进步。
title: Green energy, financial growth, natural resources and technological development: the key driving forces to trigger the economic development
title_zh: 绿色能源、金融增长、自然资源与技术发展：推动经济发展的关键驱动力

abstract: Using data from 1835 counties from 2000 to 2019 and stacked DID (Difference in Difference) method, this paper investigates the effects of RCI (Rural credit incentive) policy on grain output. We find that implementing RCI policy significantly increases per capita grain output by 13.5% and total grain output by 15.4%, demonstrating the effectiveness of formal credit incentive mechanisms in enhancing agricultural productivity. Our analysis reveals that these effects operate through three key channels: alleviating NPL (Non-Performing Loan) ratios, promoting credit expansion, and encouraging agricultural machinery investment. Notably, these impacts are more pronounced in non-major grain-producing areas and in central and eastern regions, suggesting that targeted credit incentives can help reduce regional disparities in agricultural development. These findings extend credit subsidy theory by showing how a well-designed incentive structure can overcome the limitations of traditional rural credit interventions in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2000—2019年1835个县的数据，并采用堆叠双重差分法，考察了农村信贷激励政策对粮食产出的影响。研究发现，实施农村信贷激励政策使人均粮食产量显著提高13.5%，粮食总产量显著提高15.4%，表明正规信贷激励机制在提升农业生产率方面具有有效性。分析进一步揭示，这些效应通过三条关键渠道发挥作用：降低不良贷款率、促进信贷扩张以及鼓励农业机械投资。值得注意的是，这些影响在非粮食主产区以及中部和东部地区更为显著，表明有针对性的信贷激励有助于缩小农业发展的地区差距。这些发现拓展了信贷补贴理论，说明设计良好的激励机制能够克服发展中国家传统农村信贷干预的局限性。

title: Grain growth through rural credit incentive policy: new evidence from China
